extracted.name: Maple Cream Cheese Frosting
extracted.description: This easy-to-make 4-ingredient cream cheese frosting recipe is sweetened with maple syrup for a delicious twist — enough to frost a 12-inch square cake.
instruction_lines: Beat cream cheese and butter together in a large bowl with an electric mixer until well combined. Beat in confectioners’ sugar and maple syrup until smooth. Store in the refrigerator until ready to frost.
